title: Japanese-Style Tofu Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry recipe featuring pan-seared tofu and mixed vegetables.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add bok choy and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Add tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and rice vinegar.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened.
Garnish with additional green onions, if desired.
